meta.name: ad-lead-quality-analyzer
meta.description: For paid lead-gen and participant-recruitment ads, replaces vanity CPA with true CAC per qualified lead by joining ad-platform data with downstream funnel events, surfaces tracking gaps, and classifies every creative into Scale / Keep / Investigate / Cut.

copy.tagline: 按真实获客成本分类广告素材，找出追踪漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果投放付费广告却只盯着表面CPA，想看清每个渠道的真实获客成本。
copy.tagline_en: Classify ad creatives by true CAC and uncover tracking gaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run paid ads but only track vanity CPA and need real cost per qualified lead.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析付费广告的线索质量：合并广告平台和你的下游数据，计算每个合格线索的真实获客成本，并把每个广告素材分为“放量”“保留”“调查”“关停”四类。
howto.when: 当你询问哪些广告带来了真实线索、想了解每个合格线索的真实成本、或怀疑低单次转化成本的广告其实质量很差时触发。

say.text: 分析我们最近两周的广告线索质量，按真实获客成本排序。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供广告数据和下游转化数据。

say.text: 检查一下哪些广告素材看起来转化成本低但实际线索质量差。
say.note: Claude 会识别出需要关停的“虚假赢家”素材。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes paid ad lead quality: it joins ad-platform data with your downstream funnel, computes true CAC per qualified lead, and classifies each creative into Scale / Keep / Investigate / Cut.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask which ads bring real leads, want true CAC per qualified lead, or suspect low-CPA campaigns have poor downstream quality.

say_en.text: Analyze our ad lead quality for the last two weeks, sorted by true CAC.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for ad data and downstream conversion data.

say_en.text: Check which creatives look cheap but actually have poor lead quality.
say_en.note: Claude will identify 'false winners' that should be cut.
